brief:
Israeli forces killed four Palestinians, including a child, and wounded several others in attacks across Gaza on Saturday, IMEMC News reported. The killings marked a continued pattern of violations, occurring on the 345th consecutive day of breaches to a ceasefire agreement.

The deaths add to the mounting toll in the besieged territory as military operations persist across multiple locations in the strip.
dek: On Saturday, Israeli forces killed four Palestinians, including a child, and wounded several others in attacks across the besieged Gaza Strip, as Israel violated the “ceasefire agreement” for the 345th consecutive day.
title: Israeli forces kill four Palestinians including child in Gaza
